subject: Evaluation dataset handshake, MAP timeline & usage constraints
messages:
From: Jennifer Park <jennifer@cloudcart.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Eval dataset + MAP for pilot

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profiles looked promising. We'd like to run a short evaluation with Redwood to validate generation quality and cost at scale before committing to a Dedicated pool.

High level ask: can you provide a small, representative evaluation dataset (safely redacted), a prompt pack/testcases set, and a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, deliverables, and a target close timeline? We need to understand legal/usage constraints up front (e.g., whether the dataset can be used for benchmarking only, or if Redwood can use derivatives).

Timing: CloudCart is aiming for an internal decision by Nov 20; a 2-week hands-on evaluation window would fit our calendar.

Could you share a draft MAP + sample assets and any EULA we need to sign?

Thanks,
Jennifer
Jennifer Park
Dir. of ML Engineering | CloudCart
 jennifer@cloudcart.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer@cloudcart.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Eval dataset + MAP for pilot

Jennifer — great to hear and happy to run the evaluation. I've attached a short MAP and a small sample pack to get started. High-level bullets below; attached PDF has the full mutual action plan: CloudCart_MAP_v1.pdf.

Summary / constraints (short):
- Eval assets we're providing: eval_dataset_subset.csv (redacted examples), prompt_pack_sample.zip (seed prompts & expected-output checks).
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only. CloudCart may use the materials solely to run a technical evaluation and internal benchmarking for the purpose of procurement. No training, fine-tuning, or public redistribution of the dataset or any derivative datasets is permitted.
- Retention: dataset must be deleted or returned within 90 days of delivery unless an extension is signed.
- Auditability: Redwood will enable token-level logging tied to the dataset bucket; CloudCart may request redacted logs for verification.
- Watermarking / provenance: our dataset includes subtle non-functional markers to help detect misuse; do not remove markers.

Deliverables & timeline (draft):
1) Day 0 (after signed EULA): S3 access to eval_dataset_subset.csv + prompt pack.
2) Week 1: baseline runs + sanity checks; Redwood provides a seeded test harness.
3) Week 2: deeper runs, cost/latency breakdown, quality report, recommended config (batching / quant).
4) Week 3: decision checkpoint / optional canary roll.

Please review the attached MAP. We require an executed Eval EULA (attached as Eval_EULA_DocuSign.pdf) prior to dataset delivery. I'm sharing a Drive folder for the assets here: https://drive.redwood/example/CloudCart/eval-pack and a HubSpot deal for tracking: https://hubspot.example/deal/453.

Next steps: if that looks good, we'll send a DocuSign EULA link and scope the kickoff call (30–45m). Proposed kickoff: Fri Nov 6, 10:00am PT.

Attaching: CloudCart_MAP_v1.pdf, prompt_pack_sample.zip, eval_dataset_subset.csv, Eval_EULA_DocuSign.pdf

—Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer@cloudcart.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Eval dataset + MAP for pilot — testcases & delivery notes

Jennifer / team — quick tech note from Marissa (SE) on dataset shape and what we'll need to run the harness: 

Checklist (for the subset):
- File: eval_dataset_subset.csv — CSV with header: case_id, customer_text, metadata.json (as JSON string), redact_flag
- Minimum: 500 examples for representative coverage; we can work with smaller samples but metrics will be noisy.
- PII: please ensure any PII is redacted or tokenized; if you prefer, we can run an internal redaction pass (requires additional NDA language).
- Labels: include expected_output (optional) for seed scoring; if you provide gold outputs we'll include automated BLEU/EM/ROUGE style checks + token-level matchers.
- Testcases: eval_testcases_v0.jsonl included; these are the harness inputs + scorer configs.

Also: we recommend a short companion file mapping prompt variants to customer personas. That helps make the prompt pack deterministic for scoring.

If CloudCart needs the dataset staged in their S3 with cross-account read-only access, include a role ARN and we'll set it up. Otherwise we can provide pre-signed URLs for the sample files.

I'll be on the kickoff if scheduled.

—Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Tom Cook <tom.cook@cloudcart.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Jennifer Park <jennifer@cloudcart.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Eval dataset + MAP for pilot — quick clarifications

Vanessa / Marissa — thanks for the detail. A couple clarifications from CloudCart: 

1) On training/derivatives: we understand the restriction, but for internal benchmarking we often produce quantized/normalized versions of the dataset (fixed tokenization) to measure throughput and quantization impact. Is creating ephemeral derived versions for internal-only benchmarking (deleted after the eval window) allowed?

2) Metrics / reporting: we plan to publish aggregate metrics internally and to our board (accuracy, latency, cost per 1k tokens). Are aggregate, non-identifying metrics (no text excerpts) permitted to be shared outside CloudCart?

3) Timing: Nov 6 kickoff works. We'll aim for the 2-week window you suggested. Please send the DocuSign link for the EULA and the S3 role if you're provisioning cross-account access.

We're comfortable signing the EULA; just want to confirm the two items above.

—Tom Cook
Head of Product | CloudCart
 tom.cook@cloudcart.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Tom Cook <tom.cook@cloudcart.ai>, Jennifer Park <jennifer@cloudcart.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Eval dataset + MAP for pilot — final clarifications & DocuSign

Tom / Jennifer — thanks for the questions. Short answers and confirmation below; I've included the signed EULA flow link so we can proceed once the EULA is executed.

On derived ephemeral assets: allowed for internal benchmarking only, provided:
- No external distribution or use for model training/fine-tuning.
- Any derived dataset must be tracked (we ask teams to tag derived files with the original case_id prefixes and include a short derivation manifest).
- Ephemeral datasets must be deleted at the end of the agreed retention period (default 90 days).

On aggregate metrics: yes, you may publish aggregate, non-identifying metrics (e.g., latency percentiles, aggregate accuracy rates) externally. Please do not include verbatim example generations from the dataset in external materials without express permission.

DocuSign & access: https://docusign.com/link/EVAL-EULA-453 — once signed we'll provision the S3 role (or send pre-signed URLs). We'll also enable token-level logging and share redacted logs on request.

Kickoff: Confirming Fri Nov 6, 10:00am PT. Invite will be sent separately (30 min).

Attachments: CloudCart_MAP_v1.pdf (final draft), Eval_EULA_DocuSign.pdf (for signature), prompt_pack_sample.zip

Next steps:
- Tom / Jennifer: sign the EULA via DocuSign link.
- Vanessa/Marissa: provision S3 role or pre-signed URLs; stage eval_testcases_v0.jsonl.
- Week 0: kickoff & baseline plan.

If anything in the MAP needs edits, call it out in the Doc with comments and we'll iterate quickly — aim is to get asset access within 24 hours of the EULA signature.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
